d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how Tanzanian opposition activist and key CHADEMA member Twaha Mwaipaya has been reportedly abducted in broad daylight while travelling by taxi near Nairobi. Intercepted by three vehicles, Mwaipaya was taken by unidentified men, leaving human rights groups and opposition leaders urgently demanding answers. CHADEMA has issued a direct appeal to Kenyan President William Ruto to intervene and ensure his safe return, warning that cross-border abductions erode Kenya's status as a haven for political exiles.
